description: Fetches Selenium logs (web), Appium logs (mobile/Appium), or instrumentation logs (mobile/XCUI/Espresso) for a specific automation test. Automatically detects XCUI and Espresso tests and fetches the correct log type.

platform.description: The platform type: "web" for Selenium logs, "app" for Appium/instrumentation logs

sessionId.description: Required for app platform: the session ID of the app test

testId.description: The ID of the automation test to fetch logs for

name: getAutomationTestSeleniumLogs
title: Get Automation Test Selenium Logs
